# Incident Report: S-SFX-010 Power Outage

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-SFX-010`
- **Confidence:** medium (The direct alarms (mains failure, low battery, site down) were observed on the affected node and match the KPI and anomaly timeline precisely. Maintenance windows and configuration changes were checked and ruled out via T4 and T5, while external events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-22 17:00 to 2026-09-22 20:58
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-22 13:21
- **Affected:** S-SFX-010

## Summary

A mains power failure on site S-SFX-010 led to battery depletion and a full site outage.

Site S-SFX-010 experienced a complete outage starting at 17:00 on 2026-09-22 due to power failure, with availability and active users dropping to 0. Recovery occurred at 20:58 when mains power and site availability were fully restored.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-22 13:21: Major MAINS_FAILURE alarm raised on S-SFX-010. [T3, ALM-000484]
- 2026-09-22 16:46: Major BATTERY_LOW alarm raised on S-SFX-010. [T3, ALM-000486]
- 2026-09-22 17:00: Traffic, active users, and availability drop anomaly and KPI deviation begin on S-SFX-010. [T1, T6, ALR-0033, ANM-000266, ANM-000267, ANM-000268]
- 2026-09-22 17:01: Critical SITE_DOWN alarm raised on S-SFX-010. [T3, ALM-000488]
- 2026-09-22 20:58: Mains power restored, clearing alarms MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN on S-SFX-010. [T3, ALM-000484, ALM-000486, ALM-000488]
- 2026-09-22 21:00: S-SFX-010 availability and traffic metrics recover to baseline levels, ending ALR-0033. [T1, T6, ALR-0033]

## Evidence

- S-SFX-010 experienced a mains failure starting at 2026-09-22 13:21. [T3, ALM-000484]
- Battery low alarm occurred at 2026-09-22 16:46 followed by site down at 2026-09-22 17:01. [T3, ALM-000486, ALM-000488]
- Availability and active users dropped to 0 from 2026-09-22 17:00 until recovery at 21:00. [T1, T6, ALR-0033, ANM-000266, ANM-000267, ANM-000268]
- No maintenance windows or configuration changes were scheduled or executed on S-SFX-010 or its parent nodes during the incident window. [T4, T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-SFX-010: confirmed. Direct alarms for mains failure, low battery, and site down explicitly demonstrate a power outage on S-SFX-010 matching the exact impact window. [T3, ALM-000484, ALM-000486, ALM-000488]
2. **bad_change** at S-SFX-010: rejected. No configuration changes were recorded on S-SFX-010 or its ancestors during the timeframe. [T5]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-SFX-010: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SFX-010 or its ancestors during the timeframe. [T4]

## Ruled out

- ALR-0034: Alert ALR-0034 relates to a separate ongoing event starting on 2026-09-23 09:15 affecting different site nodes (S-SAH-001, S-SAH-003, S-SAH-011), unrelated to S-SFX-010.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the site power supply system and backup batteries on S-SFX-010 to prevent recurrence of extended mains failure impact.
